# Chapter 1 — Beat 1
# Brackenwall / Protocol
## CURRENT LOCKED DIALOGUE — TRUE-VOICE / DIALOGUE-ECONOMY PASS

**Status:** CURRENT ATOMIC DIALOGUE AUTHORITY — 2026-09-19

## [BRACKENWALL — INTAKE]

The recovered Card is brought into formal Brackenwall intake.

**CUSTODY OFFICER:** That's the Card?

**CYANIS:** Card survived. Casing didn't.

**CUSTODY OFFICER:** And right now?

**ILYRA:** Inert. That's not the same as safe.

**CUSTODY OFFICER:** Wasn't hoping it was. Tell me what it actually did.

**ILYRA:** Twice, green-and-gold geometry spread from it and held damaged structure together around us. Same reaction from Cyanis both times—pulse up, tremor, dizziness afterward. Still no damn idea why.

**CYANIS:** Her favorite answer.

**ILYRA:** Only when it's true.

The officer looks at Cyanis.

**CUSTODY OFFICER:** Anything now?

Cyanis considers the question instead of answering automatically.

**CYANIS:** No dizziness. Head's clear. Nothing new.

**CUSTODY OFFICER:** Good enough for intake.

**ILYRA:** For intake.

**CUSTODY OFFICER:** I heard you.

He takes possession of the Card.

**CUSTODY OFFICER:** Warded storage until Caelora tells us what we've got.

The officer moves away with it.

Within moments, Cyanis falters.

**ILYRA:** Cyanis.

**CYANIS:** Yeah. I know.

A thin green-gold response wakes across the Card, extending back toward him.

**ILYRA:** Don't move.

**CYANIS:** Wasn't planning anything ambitious.

The officer has already stopped.

**CUSTODY OFFICER:** Bringing it back.

The Card returns.

The response collapses. Cyanis steadies.

**ILYRA:** Better?

**CYANIS:** Almost immediately.

**ILYRA:** Pulse is settling.

The officer gives the Card back to Cyanis.

**CUSTODY OFFICER:** That's the end of that experiment.

**CYANIS:** Best damn decision I've heard today.

**CUSTODY OFFICER:** It wasn't an experiment when I started it.

**ILYRA:** It is now.

The officer gives her a tired look.

**CUSTODY OFFICER:** Fine. Accidental experiment. Finished.

**CYANIS:** Even better.

**CUSTODY OFFICER:** Get Commander Solmar.

---

Maevra arrives shortly afterward, one arm already secured in a field splint.

**MAEVRA:** I'm assuming normal procedure went beautifully.

**CYANIS:** Depends how attached you are to the word normal.

**CUSTODY OFFICER:** Storage failed.

**MAEVRA:** Of course it did.

Ilyra notices the splint.

**ILYRA:** Convoy?

**MAEVRA:** Wagon threw me. Ground won.

**ILYRA:** I'm redoing that before we leave.

**MAEVRA:** Hello, Ilyra.

**ILYRA:** Hello. I'm redoing that before we leave.

Maevra looks at Cyanis.

**MAEVRA:** See what I live with?

**CYANIS:** I was going to say she seems consistent.

**ILYRA:** Thank you.

**MAEVRA:** Nobody asked you to encourage her.

The custody officer cuts back in.

**CUSTODY OFFICER:** I moved the Card away from Dovaren. He started going down. The Card reacted toward him. I brought it back. Both stopped.

The humor leaves Maevra.

**MAEVRA:** Anything still wrong?

**ILYRA:** No tremor now. Pulse is nearly baseline. He says he feels normal again.

**CYANIS:** I do.

**MAEVRA:** I believe you. I also know your definition of normal.

**CYANIS:** Damn. That's hurtful.

**MAEVRA:** Recover later.

She looks back to the officer.

**MAEVRA:** Card stays with Dovaren. Amarin keeps an eye on him. If anything changes, we stop and reassess. Nobody tests the distance again.

**CUSTODY OFFICER:** Fine by me.

**CYANIS:** Understood.

**MAEVRA:** Brackenwall can't answer this. Caelora might.

**CUSTODY OFFICER:** So you're taking it there.

**MAEVRA:** I'm taking responsibility for it. Yes.

The decision is made.

**MAEVRA:** I can get us to Greenhollow. Before we go farther south, I want Torren Harth.

**CYANIS:** All right.

Maevra starts to turn away.

**CYANIS:** And you're coming with us like that?

She looks at the splint.

**MAEVRA:** I'm traveling. I'm not fighting.

**CYANIS:** Wasn't telling you not to come.

**MAEVRA:** I know.

**ILYRA:** Good. Sit down.

**MAEVRA:** Fuck, I knew this part was coming.

**CYANIS:** That sounded like an order.

**MAEVRA:** Hers usually do when bones are involved.

**ILYRA:** Sit.

**MAEVRA:** Yes, Warden.

### [GAMEPLAY HANDOFF]

Player control returns in Brackenwall.

**Objective: Prepare to leave for Greenhollow.**

## CURRENT LOCKED DIALOGUE — TRUE-VOICE / DIALOGUE-ECONOMY PASS

## [GAMEPLAY — BRIAR PASSAGE]

Player control is active.

The group leaves Brackenwall and enters Briar Passage.

Ordinary traversal shows Cyanis on the field. Random encounters use **Cyanis + Ilyra**. Maevra remains with the group but does not participate in combat.

Most of the route is silent.

## [HALFWAY STOP]

Roughly halfway to Greenhollow, the group stops briefly at a natural break in the route.

**CYANIS:** How much farther?

**MAEVRA:** Not much. Greenhollow's straightforward from here.

**ILYRA:** You say that like the first half wasn't a pain in the ass.

**MAEVRA:** It wasn't difficult. It was Briar.

**CYANIS:** Useful distinction.

**MAEVRA:** You'll appreciate it later. This stretch I trust. South of Greenhollow, I don't trust my memory that much anymore.

**ILYRA:** Changed that much?

**MAEVRA:** Not all at once. That's the problem. One washout, one new cut, one route people stop using—and six months later you're confidently wrong.

A beat.

**MAEVRA:** That's why I want Torren. He spends more time out there than I do.

**ILYRA:** Useful.

**MAEVRA:** Very.

Maevra starts moving again.

**MAEVRA:** Come on. Greenhollow before this becomes a briefing.

**ILYRA:** You started it.

**MAEVRA:** And I'm ending it.

Player control resumes.

## [GAMEPLAY — SECOND HALF]

The party continues through Briar Passage.

No additional authored conversation interrupts the route.

Random encounters continue with Cyanis and Ilyra.

The route remains comparatively legible.

Eventually the player reaches Greenhollow through normal traversal.

There is no separate arrival conversation at the town threshold.

## [GAMEPLAY HANDOFF]

**Location: Greenhollow**

Traveling group:
**Cyanis + Ilyra + Maevra**

Combat party:
**Cyanis + Ilyra**

Next mandatory scene:
**Greenhollow / Torren**

# Chapter 1 — Beat 3
# Greenhollow / Torren
## CURRENT LOCKED DIALOGUE — TRUE-VOICE / DIALOGUE-ECONOMY PASS

**Status:** CURRENT ATOMIC DIALOGUE AUTHORITY — 2026-09-19

## [GREENHOLLOW — ROUTE BOARD]

Torren is at the route board when the group finds him.

**MAEVRA:** Torren.

He looks over.

**TORREN:** Maevra.

His eyes go to the splint.

**TORREN:** What happened?

**MAEVRA:** Convoy. Wagon threw me. Ground won.

**TORREN:** Broke it?

**MAEVRA:** Yeah.

**MAEVRA:** Amarin redid the splint this morning.

Torren looks to Ilyra.

**TORREN:** Holding?

**ILYRA:** It will.

He looks back at Maevra.

**TORREN:** Good.

**MAEVRA:** Lovely to see you too.

**TORREN:** You showed up broken.

**MAEVRA:** Splinted.

**TORREN:** Still broken.

**MAEVRA:** There he is.

Torren lets that sit, then gets to the point.

**TORREN:** What do you need?

**MAEVRA:** Caelora. South through Briar.

**TORREN:** Direct road's Host now. Briar's possible.

**MAEVRA:** Current?

**TORREN:** North end, yes. My full south pass is three days old. That's old enough for weather or Host movement to change parts of it.

A beat.

**TORREN:** Hollow Watch first.

**MAEVRA:** What's wrong with it?

**TORREN:** Host took it about a week ago. Since then, timber, rope, pulley gear, extra food going uphill. More than the fort needs.

**CYANIS:** Digging?

**TORREN:** Looks like it. Couldn't get close enough to see what the hell they were doing.

**ILYRA:** Anyone come out?

**TORREN:** No garrison. No prisoners. I got as far as the lower bend and came back.

Maevra looks at him.

**MAEVRA:** Alone?

**TORREN:** I came back.

**MAEVRA:** Not the point.

**TORREN:** I know.

Cyanis looks at the route board.

**CYANIS:** Can you get us close without using the main road?

**TORREN:** Yes. West side to the ridge. Last stretch I haven't walked since they took the fort.

**CYANIS:** That'll do.

## [THE CARD]

**MAEVRA:** One complication. Dovaren's carrying a recovered Card. Separating it from him made him sick.

Torren looks at Cyanis, then Ilyra.

**TORREN:** Travel?

**ILYRA:** Yes. Fight and climb too. If that changes, I'll say so.

**TORREN:** Then it doesn't change the route.

Cyanis looks at him.

**CYANIS:** Works for me.

## [HOLLOW WATCH DECISION]

Torren looks back toward the north side of town.

**TORREN:** I'll go with you. We settle Hollow Watch, then I take you south.

**MAEVRA:** That's the plan.

### [GAMEPLAY HANDOFF]

Torren joins as **temporary combat support** for the Hollow Watch operation.

Traveling group:
**Cyanis + Ilyra + Maevra + Torren**

Combat party:
**Cyanis + Ilyra + Torren**

Maevra remains noncombat.

**Objective: Approach Hollow Watch.**

## CURRENT LOCKED DIALOGUE — TRUE-VOICE / DIALOGUE-ECONOMY PASS

**Status:** CURRENT ATOMIC DIALOGUE AUTHORITY — 2026-09-19

## [STORY TRIGGER — HOLLOW WATCH REVEAL]

The route reaches a point where Hollow Watch becomes clearly visible.

The group stops.

For the first time, the player gets a clean view of the small Yahtrean cliff fort under Black Host occupation, active excavation below it, and older fitted stone exposed beneath the later construction.

**CYANIS:** That's Hollow Watch?

**TORREN:** Yeah.

**MAEVRA:** They've done a hell of a lot more than occupy it.

**ILYRA:** Stone underneath is different.

Torren studies it.

**TORREN:** Yeah. Couldn't see that from the lower bend. Fort's sitting over something older.

**ILYRA:** Any sign of the garrison?

Torren watches the fort for a moment.

**TORREN:** Nothing I trust from here.

Maevra looks toward the obvious road.

**MAEVRA:** Main approach?

**TORREN:** No. West wall. Trees cover most of the climb, and the last stretch tucks under the cliff. I checked it to the ridge, not past it.

Cyanis looks toward the west side.

**CYANIS:** Then that's our way in.

**TORREN:** Stay low until we're under the wall.

The stop ends.

## [GAMEPLAY — FINAL APPROACH]

The party follows Torren's west-wall approach.

## [GAMEPLAY — OCCUPIED FORT]

## [STORY TRIGGER — GARRISON DISCOVERY]

The party reaches the dead Hollow Watch garrison.

The visual fact lands before anyone speaks.

Ilyra makes the minimum check needed.

**CYANIS:** Anyone?

A beat.

**ILYRA:** No.

Silence.

Torren looks over the dead.

**TORREN:** Fuck.

Another beat.

**TORREN:** Should've come sooner.

Maevra answers quietly.

**MAEVRA:** You couldn't take that fort alone.

**TORREN:** I know. Doesn't make this better.

Maevra lets it stand.

Nobody tries to fix the silence.

After a moment, Cyanis looks toward the route deeper into the fort.

**CYANIS:** We follow them down.

Torren nods once.

**TORREN:** Yeah.

Ilyra remains still.

**ILYRA:** Give me a second.

Nobody argues.

A short pause.

Then she turns away herself.

**ILYRA:** All right.

The scene ends.

# Chapter 1 — Beat 6
# Hollow Watch Excavation
## CURRENT LOCKED DIALOGUE — 12-BEAT CONTINUITY PASS

**Status:** CURRENT ATOMIC DIALOGUE AUTHORITY — 2026-09-25  
**Protected wording source:** `DIYSE_Chapters_0-3_Spoiler_Free_Exact_Dialogue_Reader_CURRENT(6).docx`

## [GAMEPLAY — DESCENT BELOW HOLLOW WATCH]

Player control is active.

The party follows the Black Host excavation beneath the fort.

The underground sequence is deliberately compact:

**fort foundation → Black Host excavation → buried Diysean corridor / few rooms → active Constructs**

Black Host personnel do not appear once the party enters the Diysean corridor.

Ordinary underground encounters are Constructs only.

Combat party:
**Cyanis + Ilyra + Torren**

Maevra remains with the traveling group but does not participate in combat.

## [BRIEF REACTION — EXCAVATION TRANSITION]

As the party moves beyond the recognizable fort foundations:

**TORREN:** That's not fort work anymore. Fort was built around this.

**MAEVRA:** Host kept cutting anyway.

The group keeps moving.

There is no stop for further analysis.

## [ENVIRONMENTAL DISCOVERY — CIVILIAN-USE RELIEF]

In one of the few accessible ancient rooms, a surviving relief band shows ordinary people moving through the structure: adults, children, handcarts, animals, and injured people carried on litters.

The imagery suggests movement in more than one direction.

The room is allowed to land visually before anyone speaks.

Cyanis looks across the surviving imagery.

**CYANIS:** Evacuation?

Torren does not answer immediately.

**TORREN:** Maybe. They're moving both ways. Could've been people getting out, moving between places, sheltering. Relief doesn't tell us which.

Ilyra studies the figures on litters.

**ILYRA:** But they expected people who couldn't move on their own.

Maevra takes in the scale of it.

**MAEVRA:** And a lot of them. That's enough for now.

No one tries to solve the structure's original purpose.

The Card remains inert.

## [FIXED ENCOUNTER — SHIELD CONSTRUCT]

Farther along the short corridor, the party enters a room containing a dormant Shield Construct.

It is already standing in the room.

As the party progresses into the space, it activates.

There is no pre-fight dialogue.

**FIXED BATTLE — SHIELD CONSTRUCT**

Combat party:
**Cyanis + Ilyra + Torren**

Maevra does not participate.

The Shield Construct is:
- stronger than an ordinary Construct;
- not random;
- not a miniboss;
- not a route gate;
- not connected to a Card reaction;
- not given a phase transition or boss-style aftermath.

There is no mid-battle dialogue.

After victory, the party continues normally.

## [GAMEPLAY — FINAL CORRIDOR]

Environmental evidence remains deliberately inconclusive about why the Black Host excavation ended.

The party cannot establish whether:
- the Black Host found what it wanted and withdrew;
- the awakened Constructs drove it out;
- or some combination of events occurred.

The short corridor reaches the final ancient room.

## [GAMEPLAY HANDOFF]

Next mandatory scene:
**Beat 7 — Hollow Watch Landscape Depiction**

# Chapter 1 — Beat 7
# Hollow Watch Landscape Depiction
## CURRENT LOCKED DIALOGUE — 12-BEAT CONTINUITY PASS

**Status:** CURRENT ATOMIC DIALOGUE AUTHORITY — 2026-09-25  
**Protected wording source:** `DIYSE_Chapters_0-3_Spoiler_Free_Exact_Dialogue_Reader_CURRENT(6).docx`

## [STORY TRIGGER — LANDSCAPE DEPICTION]

The short ancient corridor opens into its final room.

A large surviving landscape depiction is allowed to land before anyone speaks.

It depicts:
- fire falling from the sky across the region;
- ordinary people moving toward and down into multiple constructed entrances;
- recognizable regional geography;
- Hollow Watch;
- farther south, the crossroads Torren knows as the Junction;
- a prominent ancient structure standing at that crossroads that does not exist visibly in the present day.

A long beat.

**ILYRA:** Same kind of movement as downstairs. More places.

**MAEVRA:** So it wasn't local.

Torren has stopped listening to the rest of the room.

**TORREN:** Wait.

He studies the terrain.

**TORREN:** That's Hollow Watch.

Cyanis looks at him.

**CYANIS:** You're sure?

**TORREN:** Yeah. Ridge, slope, the break west of it. It's simplified, but that's this ground.

That changes the image.

**MAEVRA:** Then the rest may be real too.

Torren follows the geography south.

A beat.

**TORREN:** Fuck.

**ILYRA:** What?

**TORREN:** The Junction. Same basin, same road convergence. I know that ground.

A beat.

**TORREN:** I don't know that.

His attention is fixed on the prominent structure depicted at the crossroads.

**MAEVRA:** You've never seen it?

**TORREN:** No. Could be gone, could be buried, could be the picture's wrong about the size. But if something like that were standing there now, I wouldn't have missed it.

A brief silence.

**MAEVRA:** We're already going south.

**TORREN:** Junction's close enough to the route.

**MAEVRA:** Then we look when we get there.

**TORREN:** Yeah. Until then, it's something that should be there and isn't.

**CYANIS:** I'll take that.

## [TRANSITION — GREENHOLLOW]

Hollow Watch is finished.

There is no playable backtrack through the underground site, no overlook resolution scene, and no second discussion of the Junction.

The game transitions directly back to Greenhollow.

## [GAMEPLAY HANDOFF]

Next mandatory scene:
**Beat 8 — Greenhollow Resolution / Torren Recruitment**

# Chapter 1 — Beat 8
# Greenhollow Resolution / Torren Recruitment
## CURRENT LOCKED DIALOGUE — 12-BEAT CONTINUITY PASS

**Status:** CURRENT ATOMIC DIALOGUE AUTHORITY — 2026-09-25  
**Protected wording source:** `DIYSE_Chapters_0-3_Spoiler_Free_Exact_Dialogue_Reader_CURRENT(6).docx`

## [GREENHOLLOW — RETURN]

The game transitions directly from Hollow Watch back to Greenhollow.

The immediate report is short and practical.

A local response begins organizing for Hollow Watch: the dead must be recovered, the surface secured, and a proper Yahtrean force warned about what lies below.

Maevra gives only the information needed to act.

**MAEVRA:** The garrison's dead. Host occupation is broken, but the fort isn't secure enough to call restored. Get word to Brackenwall. Recover the dead, hold the surface, and nobody goes below until a proper force gets here.

The local response takes over.

There is no detailed retelling of the excavation, Construct encounters, or landscape depiction.

## [TORREN]

Once the immediate report is finished, Torren watches Greenhollow's response beginning to move.

**TORREN:** They'll handle it from here.

Maevra looks at him.

**MAEVRA:** You satisfied with that?

Torren considers the question.

**TORREN:** No. Doesn't matter. I stayed because nobody knew what happened at Hollow Watch and somebody had to keep watching it. Now we know, and Greenhollow's got people who can take it from here.

Maevra nods once.

**MAEVRA:** So. You still taking us south?

**TORREN:** Yeah.

A short beat.

**TORREN:** And I'm not turning around at Dunmere. If you're still going to Caelora after that, I'm coming.

**MAEVRA:** Good.

Torren looks at her.

**TORREN:** Don't sound so pleased.

**MAEVRA:** I came here to ask you.

## [SOUTHWARD PLAN]

Maevra turns back to the journey.

**MAEVRA:** Dunmere's still next.

**TORREN:** Through southern Briar. Junction's close enough to check on the way.

Nobody reopens the landscape-depiction discussion.

Cyanis looks toward the south end of town.

**CYANIS:** Then we resupply and move.

**ILYRA:** After food. I'm starving.

Cyanis looks at her.

**CYANIS:** That sounded pretty damn final.

**ILYRA:** I'm hungry.

**TORREN:** There's a place near the south road.

**MAEVRA:** Finally, useful route information.

Torren looks at her.

**TORREN:** Been giving you useful route shit for years.

**MAEVRA:** This one involves lunch.

**TORREN:** Lower standard.

**MAEVRA:** Better standard.

The tension breaks naturally, and the scene ends.

## [SYSTEM / PARTY STATE]

**TORREN HARTH — PERMANENT PARTY MEMBER**

Permanent combat party:
**Cyanis + Ilyra + Torren**

Maevra remains a non-combat traveling companion.

Player control returns in Greenhollow.

## [STORY TRIGGER — THORNHIDE TRACK]

The group stops.

# Chapter 1 — Beat 11
# The Junction / Hidden Monument
## CURRENT LOCKED DIALOGUE — 12-BEAT CONTINUITY PASS

**Status:** CURRENT ATOMIC DIALOGUE AUTHORITY — 2026-09-25  
**Protected wording source:** `DIYSE_Chapters_0-3_Spoiler_Free_Exact_Dialogue_Reader_CURRENT(6).docx`

## [GAMEPLAY — ARRIVAL AT THE JUNCTION]

Player control is active.

The route rises out of Southern Briar into the old crossroads Torren knows as **the Junction**.

There are no random encounters here.

Chapter 1's combat climax is over.

The Junction itself is familiar ground to Torren: several old routes once converged here, and the modern southern road still passes through the same terrain.

The ancient structure shown in the Hollow Watch landscape depiction is not immediately recognizable.

## [STORY TRIGGER — THE HIDDEN MONUMENT]

The party reaches the center of the crossroads.

**TORREN:** This is it.

Cyanis looks around.

**CYANIS:** Then where's the thing from the mural?

**TORREN:** That's what I'm trying to figure out.

Maevra looks across the center of the Junction.

**MAEVRA:** It was in the middle.

Torren's attention settles on a broad, low mass of old fitted stone almost completely swallowed by vines and moss.

A beat.

**TORREN:** ...Shit.

Cyanis follows his look.

**CYANIS:** That?

**TORREN:** Maybe.

**MAEVRA:** You've walked past it before.

**TORREN:** I've walked past a lot of rocks.

**MAEVRA:** I'm keeping that answer.

**TORREN:** Of course you are.

The party clears the vegetation from the central stone.

This is one simple major-story interaction/state change rather than a long animation.

Beneath the vines and moss is a broad stone-and-metal cartographic surface.

The humor stops.

A beat.

**TORREN:** That's not a foundation.

Torren studies it.

**TORREN:** Route map, I think. Or close enough I'm willing to call it one. I know the ground; I don't know this system.

## [THE WAYFINDER]

The exposed surface is much larger in scope than a local route plate.

Once the surviving relationships resolve, it reads as a broad map of **western ancient Diyse**.

Dense overland route lines intersect and reconnect across the entire surviving region.

A second, visually distinct system of markings threads through the map in a different grammar.

**Production authority:** those markings correspond to underground infrastructure and routes, but Chapter 1 must not visually or verbally identify them that way yet. The party only recognizes a separate large-scale system distinct from ordinary surface roads.

Repeated built-form clusters mark numerous ancient cities or settlements.

Six familiar Face markings appear as part of the old technical grammar:

**Might. Elements. Grace. Memory. Perception. Ruin.**

Their function here is not understood.

Torren studies the surface longer.

**TORREN:** This isn't a Junction map.

Ilyra follows the route layers outward.

**ILYRA:** No.

Torren traces one set, then another without touching the surface.

**TORREN:** These are roads. These other lines aren't—or not any kind I know. They're everywhere, and I can't tell you what they mean.

Maevra looks across the repeated built-up clusters.

**MAEVRA:** And all of those?

**TORREN:** Built places. Settlements. Cities, maybe. A lot of them.

Torren comes back to the local ground first and follows a surviving alignment running southeast.

**TORREN:** This southeast line matches our road. Same direction, same bend. Could be the old road under parts of it, could just be people choosing the same good ground. Can't tell from this.

**MAEVRA:** Dunmere.

**TORREN:** Yeah.

Cyanis looks across the wider map.

**CYANIS:** So this whole thing was connected.

**TORREN:** Looks that way. Doesn't tell us how it all worked.

Farther across the surviving western map, surface routes, the second unidentified marking system, and built-up structures become markedly denser around one enormous concentration.

The physical map is broken through the middle of it.

Maevra compares the relationship against the group's known modern geography.

**MAEVRA:** If the rest of this matches, Caelora should be around there.

**TORREN:** Around the break, yeah.

He studies the missing section.

**TORREN:** Whatever stood there, it was the biggest concentration on this part of the map. Center's gone.

**CYANIS:** Of course it is.

No one attempts to draw through the break or identify the missing ancient city.

**MAEVRA:** Copy what's here.

**CYANIS:** Works for me.

Torren glances at him.

**TORREN:** See? Trainable.

Cyanis gives him a look.

**CYANIS:** Careful.

Torren goes back to the map.

## [PRACTICAL COPY]

The party makes a physical copy of as much surviving information as practical.

A brief fade/state transition is enough.

The copy preserves:
- the broad western ancient-Diyse geography;
- the dense overland route network;
- the distinct second system of markings, still unidentified by the party;
- the numerous surviving city / settlement clusters;
- the largest concentration around the geography of present-day Caelora and the exact shape/location of the physical break through its center;
- the southeast alignment corresponding to the party's existing route toward Dunmere;
- the six Face markings.

The party does **not** reconstruct or invent the missing Caelora-area center.

Dunmere is not discovered here. It was already the party's next practical destination.

## [CAMP DECISION]

Once the useful information is copied, Maevra looks toward the southern road.

**MAEVRA:** Dunmere tonight?

Torren answers without hesitation.

**TORREN:** No. Road's easy enough in daylight and annoying in the dark. After today, there's no reason to make it worse.

**MAEVRA:** All right.

**TORREN:** Camp here. Dunmere in the morning.

Cyanis looks around the quiet Junction.

**CYANIS:** Works for me.

Ilyra exhales.

**ILYRA:** Good. I was prepared to be a pain in the ass.

Maevra looks at her.

**MAEVRA:** Prepared?

**ILYRA:** More of one.

**MAEVRA:** There she is.

Torren looks toward the campable ground nearby.

**TORREN:** I'll find us a decent spot.

**CYANIS:** One without any more ancient bullshit?

Torren looks back at him.

**TORREN:** That's the goal.

## [GAMEPLAY HANDOFF]

**Rest when ready and continue toward Dunmere in the morning.**

## C02 — Torren's Version of Dinner

**Atomic source:** `C02_TORRENS_VERSION_OF_DINNER_DIALOGUE.md`

# Chapter 1 — Character-Life C02
# Torren's Version of Dinner
## CURRENT LOCKED CHARACTER-LIFE DIALOGUE — TIGHTENED TRUE-VOICE PASS

### [CAMP — OPTIONAL CHARACTER-LIFE TRIGGER]

Evening at the Junction-area camp.

Cyanis, Ilyra, Torren, and Maevra are present.

Torren made dinner.

It is bad.

Not dangerous. Just hot, filling, cheap, and aggressively indifferent to pleasure.

Torren does not smoke until everyone has finished eating.

### [DINNER]

Maevra takes one bite.

Stops.

**MAEVRA:** Oh, no.

**CYANIS:** That's a strong opening.

**TORREN:** Eat.

**MAEVRA:** I've had this before. That's why I'm warning you.

Ilyra studies the food.

**ILYRA:** Dangerous?

**MAEVRA:** No. That's the annoying part.

**TORREN:** Hot. Safe. Food.

**CYANIS:** That's a piss-poor standard.

**TORREN:** Still a standard.

Cyanis tries it.

**CYANIS:** Huh.

**TORREN:** There.

**CYANIS:** I didn't say it was good.

**TORREN:** Didn't spit it out.

**ILYRA:** He's got you there.

### [WHAT IS IN IT]

**CYANIS:** What's actually in this?

**TORREN:** Beans. Onion. Root vegetables. Dried meat. Salt.

**CYANIS:** What kind of meat?

Torren pauses.

**TORREN:** Probably goat.

**ILYRA:** Probably?

**TORREN:** Tasted like goat before I put it in.

**CYANIS:** Before?

**MAEVRA:** Don't.

**TORREN:** It became dinner.

### [MAEVRA REMEMBERS]

Maevra stirs her bowl.

**MAEVRA:** You used to make this on marches.

**TORREN:** Similar.

**MAEVRA:** You made one pot so thick somebody left a spoon standing upright through watch change.

**TORREN:** Edrin dumped too much meal in.

**MAEVRA:** You handed him the bag.

**TORREN:** Didn't tell him to empty the damn thing.

**CYANIS:** And you still ate it?

**MAEVRA:** We were starving.

Cyanis looks at Torren.

**CYANIS:** Wait. You know this is bad?

**TORREN:** Course I do. I can taste.

A beat.

**TORREN:** It's hot, there's enough for everybody, it won't make us sick, ingredients were cheap, pot was easy to clean, and I didn't spend an hour fucking around with dinner after walking all day. Successful field meal.

Ilyra starts laughing.

**CYANIS:** Those are not the only qualities food can have.

**TORREN:** Cheap too.

**MAEVRA:** Fuck you.

**TORREN:** Still eating.

**ILYRA:** Not the same mechanism.

**TORREN:** Going to be a long trip.

### [AFTER DINNER]

Eventually the bowls are empty.

Torren lights a blunt from the campfire.

**CYANIS:** Does that help with the taste?

Torren considers it.

**TORREN:** Little bit.

Maevra laughs immediately.

**CYANIS:** You knew exactly how bad it was.

**TORREN:** Told you.

**MAEVRA:** I'm cooking tomorrow.

**TORREN:** Fine.

**CYANIS:** That easy?

**TORREN:** Means I don't have to cook.

Maevra realizes what happened.

**MAEVRA:** Damn it.

**ILYRA:** Still worth it.

**TORREN:** Everybody wins.

**CYANIS:** I hate that you've made this a victory.

**TORREN:** Made dinner.

Scene ends.

# Chapter 1 — Character-Life C03
# What the Map Says
## CURRENT LOCKED CHARACTER-LIFE DIALOGUE — TIGHTENED TRUE-VOICE PASS

### [CAMP — OPTIONAL CHARACTER-LIFE TRIGGER]

Later at the Junction-area camp.

Torren is updating one of his ordinary modern route maps.

Cyanis notices and stays.

This is not a second inspection of the Ancient monument.

### [THE MAP]

For a while, Cyanis says nothing.

Torren keeps working.

**TORREN:** You need something?

**CYANIS:** No.

Cyanis keeps watching.

**TORREN:** You're still there.

**CYANIS:** I noticed.

**CYANIS:** What are you changing?

**TORREN:** Road.

**CYANIS:** Helpful.

**TORREN:** Official line's wrong now. Wash moved lower, wagons started cutting higher. Old road's still there, but nobody sensible uses it wet.

**CYANIS:** So you erase it?

**TORREN:** Move the useful line. Leave the old one light if it still matters. Road doesn't give a shit what the map says. People do.

**CYANIS:** Crown cartographers would lose their damn minds.

**TORREN:** Bad ones.

### [THE NOTE]

Cyanis notices another handwritten mark.

**CYANIS:** Old slut?

**TORREN:** Bitch.

Silence.

**CYANIS:** What?

Torren looks.

**TORREN:** That says old cut.

**CYANIS:** No, it doesn't. That's an S.

**TORREN:** It's a C.

**CYANIS:** That's the worst C I've ever seen.

**TORREN:** You read it wrong.

**CYANIS:** You called me a bitch.

**TORREN:** You called me an old slut.

**CYANIS:** I asked if the map said old slut.

**TORREN:** Sounded direct from here.

Cyanis tries not to laugh.

Fails.

**TORREN:** Fuck off, you map-blind bastard.

Torren starts laughing too.

### [OLD CUT]

**CYANIS:** So what's an old cut?

**TORREN:** Older foot route. Sometimes from before a road shifted or got widened. Sometimes it's still useful. Sometimes it just tells you where people used to move.

**CYANIS:** Better answer than `road.`

**TORREN:** Better question.

Torren deliberately fixes the C.

**CYANIS:** You fixed it.

**TORREN:** Improved legibility.

### [WHY HE KEEPS HIS OWN]

**CYANIS:** You carry this and the official one?

**TORREN:** Usually. Official one's right often enough to matter. Mine's what I trust after I've walked it.

**CYANIS:** You remember most of this anyway.

**TORREN:** A lot. Not enough. Memory gets confident. Map gives me something to argue with later.

**CYANIS:** That's annoyingly good.

**TORREN:** Sounded surprised.

**CYANIS:** I was trying not to.

Cyanis points at a convergence.

**CYANIS:** Why do all three come back together there?

**TORREN:** Ground narrows between the rise and the wash. Doesn't matter where you start; eventually it forces you through the same strip.

**CYANIS:** So if I lose the road, I can still know where it has to come back.

**TORREN:** Exactly.

A little later:

**CYANIS:** I'm not reading that one out loud.

**TORREN:** Smart.

Cyanis starts away.

**CYANIS:** Good night, Torren.

**TORREN:** Night.

A beat.

**TORREN:** Bitch.

Cyanis looks back.

**CYANIS:** Old slut.

Torren's head comes up as Cyanis leaves.

Scene ends.

# Chapter 1 — Character-Life C04
# Not Professionally
## CURRENT LOCKED CHARACTER-LIFE DIALOGUE — TIGHTENED TRUE-VOICE PASS

### [CAMP — OPTIONAL CHARACTER-LIFE TRIGGER]

Later at the Junction-area camp.

Ilyra is changing the field splint on Maevra's broken arm.

This scene may confirm that Torren matters personally to Maevra and that their history is deeper than ordinary colleagues. It does not reveal how long they have known each other, their enlistment ages, past romance, breakup history, or Torren's private feelings.

### [THE SPLINT]

**ILYRA:** Give me the arm.

**MAEVRA:** Attached to me.

**ILYRA:** I noticed.

Maevra gives it to her.

Ilyra starts removing the old splint.

**MAEVRA:** Fuck.

**ILYRA:** Sorry. Not enough to stop.

**MAEVRA:** Better.

**ILYRA:** You've been using the hell out of it.

**MAEVRA:** I have duties.

**ILYRA:** You also have a fracture.

**MAEVRA:** Inconveniently, yes.

Ilyra uses a small amount of Warden magic.

**MAEVRA:** Better. Still broken?

**ILYRA:** Still broken. I can settle the pain. I can't convince bone that time is optional.

### [TORREN]

For a while, neither speaks.

**ILYRA:** You and Torren are strange.

**MAEVRA:** That's not a question.

**ILYRA:** I know.

**ILYRA:** You argue like you've already had every version of the argument.

**MAEVRA:** Usually have.

**ILYRA:** And you both know exactly when the other's about to be difficult.

**MAEVRA:** Torren is always about to be difficult.

**ILYRA:** He'd say the same about you.

**MAEVRA:** Then he'd be wrong in a very familiar way.

Ilyra tightens one wrap.

**ILYRA:** So you've known him a while.

**MAEVRA:** Long enough.

**ILYRA:** Deliberately useless.

**MAEVRA:** Yes.

A little silence.

**MAEVRA:** He thinks if the ground tells you a plan is stupid, you change the plan.

**ILYRA:** Sounds reasonable.

**MAEVRA:** It is. Then he tries to apply that to everything.

**ILYRA:** And you don't.
